name: model__prediction__influenza__matsim-episim
description: Agent-based simulation of four influenza seasons (2022/23 to 2025/26) in Cologne or Berlin on MATSim mobility, with strains, immunity and vaccination.

city.description: Scenario: Cologne (25 % sample, 588,124 agents) or Berlin (25 % sample, 1,207,780 agents).

prediction_length.description: Weeks to simulate from 2022-09-26 (Monday of ISO week 39/2022). 33 covers the first season, 190 all four seasons up to 2026-05-17.

seeds.description: Number of random seeds; the forecast interval is taken over the seeds.

gamma.description: Common calibration factor on the transmissibility of all strains; 1.0 is the calibrated configuration.

vaccination.description: Seasonal vaccination of the persons aged 60 and over with the local coverage of the KV-Impfsurveillance; false for the counterfactual without vaccination.

tasks.description: Simulations run in parallel. Each needs about 8 GB (Cologne) to 14 GB (Berlin) of memory.

dry_run.description: true checks a run without simulating: reads the inputs, rebuilds the scenario data, generates config, policy and progression and writes run_info.json and scenario/, but no predictions. Takes seconds, needs no network and little memory; for testing the platform and the inputs.

rules: The simulated period always starts on 2022-09-26; the input data do not move the start, they shape the import of infections and the vaccination.
tasks must not exceed seeds to be useful; memory has to cover tasks times the memory of one simulation.
With dry_run true only run_info.json and scenario/ are written; predictions.tsv and the other declared outputs are missing.

episerve:inputs.description: EPISERVE dataset Q8399965930733 (RKI, laboratory-confirmed influenza notifications). Shapes the weekly import of infections over the four seasons. Without it the extract baked into the image is used.

columns.name: Meldewoche
columns.description: Reporting week; 2022-W38 to 2026-W21 must be present for the region.

columns.name: Region_Id
columns.description: 5 (Nordrhein-Westfalen) is used for Cologne, 11 (Berlin) for Berlin.

columns.name: Fallzahl
columns.description: Weekly notifications; only the shape matters, the level of the import is a constant of the scenario.

episerve:inputs.description: EPISERVE dataset Q4242040001970 (WHO FluNet, Germany). The sentinel detections split the import between the A subtype of the season and B/Victoria. Without it the extract baked into the image is used.

EPISERVE dataset Q0602352424740 (RKI KV-Impfsurveillance). Influenza coverage of SK Köln (5315) or SK Berlin (11000) by age band and season; a season without data takes the last season with data. Without it the extract baked into the image is used.

episerve:outputs.description: One row per complete ISO week of the simulated period: weekly new cases in the city, scaled to the whole population, mean and 10th/90th percentile over the seeds.

columns.name: symptomatic
columns.description: New symptomatic cases, mean over the seeds; symptomatic_q10 and symptomatic_q90 follow.

columns.name: hospitalisations
columns.description: New hospitalisations (seriously sick), mean over the seeds; hospitalisations_q10 and hospitalisations_q90 follow.

columns.name: critical
columns.description: New critical cases, mean over the seeds; critical_q10 and critical_q90 follow.

episerve:outputs.description: The weekly values of every seed (long by seed).
Weekly new infections by transmission (imported infections not included) by strain and seed, for the strains of the scenario.
Weekly incidence per 100,000 by age group and seed (weeks Tuesday to Monday, labelled by their last day).

episerve:documentation.method: MATSim Episim: agents follow the daily activity patterns of a MATSim/Senozon mobility model; infections happen in shared facilities and vehicles with an age- and progression-dependent model with seasonality and weather-driven outdoor fraction. Five strains over four seasons (A(H3N2), A(H1N1)pdm09, B/Victoria), cross-protection between seasons, imported infections shaped by the IfSG notifications and split by the FluNet sentinel, school holidays, and seasonal vaccination of the persons aged 60 and over.
episerve:documentation.intendedUse: Scenario analysis of past influenza seasons in Cologne and Berlin (e.g. with and without vaccination, sensitivity to the transmissibility) and comparison with surveillance data. It is not an operational forecast: the period is fixed to 2022-09-26 to 2026-05-17. Besides the declared files a run writes run_info.json (config, image build, origin of every input), the covid-sim viewer package unpacked at the root (metadata.yaml, _info.txt, notes.md, summaries/, observed/) and scenario/ (the generated config, policy and data files as run).
episerve:documentation.limitations: 25 % samples of the population. The import follows state-level notifications (NRW for Cologne), which are testing-driven; only their shape is used. Vaccination coverage comes from statutory-insurance claims data; the campaign timing is a placeholder. The mobility of a typical weekday, Saturday and Sunday is the same over all seasons. One simulation of all four seasons takes about an hour on 8 cores.
episerve:documentation.trainingData: Calibrated by hand with the common factor gamma against the IfSG notifications and the ICOSARI SARI hospitalisations of the seasons 2022/23 to 2025/26.
